$schema_note: Non-secret custody inventory. NAMES, ROLES AND CUSTODY METADATA ONLY, per SECRET_CUSTODY_CONTRACT.SSL_06_ADJUDICATION.CONSEQUENT_BINDING_REQUIREMENT. No credential VALUE, DSN, userinfo, password hash, vault handle or lookup token may ever be added to this file, by any lane, at any beat.

entries.lifecycle_state_meaning: A credential mint has been ratified in principle (OD-1..OD-6) and this entry has been pre-created ahead of it, but no credential has been generated, minted or rotated. DAG node N11 (MR-2) has not fired. This state is expected to transition to PROVISIONED only by DAG node N12, which UPDATES this same entry — it does not append a second one.
entries.human_custodian_hole_reason: UNKNOWN. No artifact in this repository at any point measured names a specific person as custodian; OD-2 ratifies a MECHANISM (Windows Credential Manager) and a delivery POSTURE, not a person. This field must be supplied by a separately governed owner act before DAG node N06's own exit_condition can be met.
entries.custody_mechanism_detail: DPAPI-backed OS credential vault, ratified under OD-2.sub_decisions[0].
entries.delivery_mechanism_detail: Per SECRET_DELIVERY_CONTRACT.MECHANISM_2_PROCESS_SCOPED, as corrected by v1.0.2 SPC102-1 (the only candidate mechanism it leaves selectable). Never user-scope persistent; never setx. Ratified under OD-2.sub_decisions[1].
entries.delivery_mechanism_conformance_demonstra: NOT YET PERFORMED. DAG node N05 (WCM-C1..WCM-C5 conformance, on a non-secret sentinel value) remains NOT SATISFIED as of this entry. Recording the ratified mechanism choice above is not a claim that N05 has closed.
entries.processes_or_environments_hole_reason: The concrete child-process topology is part of DAG node N05's own exit_condition and is not knowable until that demonstration occurs.
entries.mint_date_hole_reason: EXPECTED to be absent. The mint (DAG node N11, MR-2) has not occurred. Populated only by DAG node N12, as an UPDATE to this entry, immediately after N11 verifies.
entries.expiry_policy: VALID_UNTIL = planned FINAL WITNESS time + 24 hours
entries.expiry_policy_basis: OD-3, ratified (RATIFIED_VALID_UNTIL_POLICY_OFFSET_24H_POST_WITNESS). An owner policy OFFSET, not yet a computable UTC timestamp.
entries.expiry_exact_utc_hole_reason: DAG node N09 computes this value from DAG node N08 (a concrete owner-supplied planned FINAL WITNESS timestamp), which remains unsupplied. No default, estimate, or open-ended value is substituted, per EXEC-NOTE-1.
entries.removal_policy: MANDATORY rotation and removal after the FINAL WITNESS
entries.planned_removal_date_hole_reason: Tied to the same unsupplied FINAL WITNESS timestamp (DAG node N08) that blocks expiry_exact_utc. Not knowable until N08 is supplied.
